title_zh: 河南省南阳市人大常委会原主任刘朝瑞接受审查调查
title_en: Former Nanyang Official Liu Chaorui under Investigation
summary_zh: 据河南省纪委监委消息，南阳市人大常委会原党组书记、主任刘朝瑞涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
summary_en: Liu Chaorui, former Party secretary and director of the Standing Committee of Nanyang Municipal People's Congress, is under disciplinary review and supervisory investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law, according to Henan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection.
body_zh:
中新网9月7日电 据河南省纪委监委消息：河南省南阳市人大常委会原党组书记、主任刘朝瑞涉嫌严重违纪违法，目前正接受河南省纪委监委纪律审查和监察调查。
